A_original_five_class.decision: reject for deployment; evaluate only as a source-label audit
A_original_five_class.reason: The classes have no clinical definitions and are not demonstrated CKD stages, severity categories, or future-risk outcomes.

B_binary_disease_vs_no_disease.decision: reject for deployment; evaluate only as a negative control
B_binary_disease_vs_no_disease.reason: Low_Risk, Moderate_Risk, and High_Risk are not documented disease diagnoses, so calling all four nonzero labels disease would be invented.

C_elevated_or_severe_group.construction_considered: No_Disease and Low_Risk=0; Moderate_Risk, High_Risk, and Severe_Disease=1
C_elevated_or_severe_group.reason: No source threshold or outcome definition justifies this boundary. Merging labels only to create a prediction task would be arbitrary.

D_do_not_deploy.outcome: C. Dataset has serious target/provenance issues and should not be deployed
D_do_not_deploy.reason: Unverifiable provenance and target construction, clinical incoherence, and chance-level full/reduced validation make deployment indefensible.
